result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Answer A keeps nearly all the original values. Answer B rewrites the stylesheet: it swaps the typeface, adds an accent colour, a drop cap and ornaments, enlarges the headings, and slightly widens the column. Those are the changes the rubric warns against. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B says the existing size, measure and leading were already sound. It keeps nearly every original value and makes a few small, explained edits: tracking, text-wrap, lining numerals and a muted kicker. Removing the blockquote border is a bigger change, though B flags it and explains how to undo it. A rewrites the stylesheet: it swaps the typeface, adds an accent color, a drop cap, ornaments and new elements, and enlarges the headings and body text, which is exactly what the rubric warns against.
